name: Angus McLeod
bio:
Angus grew up around cars, his dad owning a small panel beating shop in rural New South Wales. From a young age, he was fascinated by the transformation a fresh coat of paint could bring to a vehicle. He started helping out in the shop during school holidays, learning the basics of prepping, masking, and spraying. While he initially pursued a trade certificate in automotive painting, Angus’s true passion lay in the precision and artistry required for motorsport livery. He sees the paint shop not just as a place to apply color, but as a crucial element in a team's identity and performance. He's eager to apply his skills and develop further in a high-pressure motorsport environment, believing his eye for detail will make him a valuable asset.

Angus is known for his meticulous approach to every task. He understands the importance of flawless execution, especially in a field where even minor imperfections can affect aerodynamics and aesthetics. While still relatively new to the industry, he's committed to continuous learning and improvement, always seeking out new techniques and technologies to enhance his skills. His dream is to one day lead a team responsible for creating iconic and visually stunning race cars that leave a lasting impression on fans and competitors alike.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when the shop is quiet.
Insists on using only premium-grade masking tape, regardless of the budget.
Keeps a small notebook filled with color swatches and custom paint formulas.
